::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Packages covered in this part:** [janitor](https://sfirke.github.io/janitor/), [tidyr](https://tidyr.tidyverse.org/), [stringr](https://stringr.tidyverse.org/), [lubridate](https://lubridate.tidyverse.org/)
:::

Real data is rarely clean. Column names are inconsistent, values need
reshaping, text fields need tidying up, and dates need parsing before
they're ready for analysis. This chapter covers four packages that
handle the bulk of that work.

## Installing Packages


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages(c(
  "janitor", # for cleaning names and basic data cleaning
  "tidyr", # for reshaping data
  "stringr", # for working with text
  "lubridate" # for working with dates
))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```
:::
